title: Ten Editions and One Unsettled Line
subtitle: 语言与释义 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言与释义（生活与学习·语言学习与释义）
meta: 主题语境：语言与释义（生活与学习·语言学习与释义）　|　核心词汇：definition　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 definition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the editor ① wrote a definition that no committee in the society would have approved, and he said the writing was the whole of the entry. The ② definition, meaning the wording and not the sense, ran ten editions and stayed unchanged; a definition, he said, is the only thing in a dictionary that is judged by how long it is left unrevised.

Every ③ definition in that dictionary had the same unsettled line under it, and the ④ definition at the end, meaning the one they kept for the appendix and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever queried twice. A definition, his assistant said, is nine parts usage and one part somebody willing to write; the editor said the usage is the part that fills ten editions.

The philosopher meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the definition was the whole of the argument, meaning the sense and not the wording. The ⑥ definition, meaning the sense and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody quotes and nobody accepts; definition, she said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a wording and a sense. She said the sense is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ definition had become a line in a preface, and the preface had become an argument about the unsettled line. The ⑧ definition of the whole thing, the editor wrote in August, was one dictionary and ten editions of usage; definition, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to revise. She said the revising was never mentioned.

The ⑨ definition I remember is the one at the end, which was revised in 1977 and is still described as the clearest in the dictionary. A ⑩ definition, the assistant said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being revised; every definition, she said, is a sense that has agreed to look like a wording. She said the sense was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 释义；定义（指词典里写出的那一条）
B. n. 释义（指那些措辞本身，与那个含义相对）
C. 固定搭配：write a definition 撰写一条释义
D. n. 释义（指留给附录用的那一条）
E. n. 释义；界定（抽象总称，指一部词典的全部释义工作）
F. n. 释义（指前言里写到、被提及的那一条）
G. n. 定义；含义（指争论中援引的那个义界）
H. n. 义界（抽象总称，指人人援引却无人接受的那个）

answers.why: write a definition 意为“撰写一条释义”，1955 年编纂者写了一条学会里没有一位委员肯批准的释义。
definition 意为“释义”，指那些措辞本身而不是那个含义，它历经十个版本而未有改动。
definition 意为“释义”，指那部词典里每一条释义，每一条下面都有同一行未定的文字。
definition 意为“释义”，指留给附录用的那一条，是唯一有人质疑过两次的。
definition 意为“定义、含义”，指争论中援引的那个义界，哲学家说这个含义就是那场争论的全部。
definition 意为“义界”，指人人援引却无人接受的那个而不是那些措辞，是争论里人人都援引、却无人接受的东西。
definition 意为“释义”，指前言里写到、被提及的那一条，到 1963 年这条释义成了前言里的一行。
definition 意为“释义、界定”，编纂者八月写道，整件事的释义是一部词典和十个版本的用例。
definition 意为“释义”，我记得的是末尾那一条，1977 年被修订，至今仍被说成词典里最清楚的一条。
definition 为抽象总称，助手 1979 年说，一条释义是唯一会因为被修订而变得更好的东西。
